Grace / team / Jordan — I reviewed Soleready's tracked MSA comments and sketched in-line guidance. Key items and recommended language:

1) Billing / proration (Order Form). We can support monthly billing with proration. Recommended order form clause: "Charges for the initial partial billing period will be prorated based on the number of days in the billing cycle and the effective date. Subsequent invoices will follow the monthly cadence outlined in Section X." This avoids tying to customer fiscal calendars.

2) Data retention carveout (MSA Section 8). Proposed compromise: Redwood will retain logs for 12 months by default; for customers requiring >12 months (up to 24 months), we can include an addendum with explicit retention and potential fee for extended storage. Suggested addendum: "Exhibit D: Extended Retention — Customer requests 18 months; fees and export procedures to be appended upon execution."

3) SLA credits for onboarding burst. Rather than an automatic credit, suggest a defined onboarding window (first 30 days) where burst overages are handled via a one‑time adjustment request to CS, with documented metrics. This prevents open ended credit liabilities.

I attached a redline extract (Soleready_MSA_comments_20290215.docx) with proposed text. Marissa — can you fold the billing language into OrderForm_v2 and include a small billing examples table so procurement can see proration math? Ben — can you confirm the onboarding window and what metrics we will use to evaluate acceptable burst behavior (p95 latency, token failure rate, etc.).

Jordan / Lisa — we are aligned to the 2029‑04‑01 effective date; for signature flow we prefer DocuSign but can accommodate a countersigned PDF if your procurement requires PO first. If you need a more specific quote for 18‑month retention, tell us and we'll price the addendum.

Thanks — Karthik
